title: 76. Where can I find the contributions submitted by my respondents?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: Where can I find the contributions submitted by my respondents.
short_answer: Open your survey in EUSurvey (also see ' How do I open an existing survey for editing etc.? ') and go to the 'Results' page. Initially, you'll see the full content of all submitted contributions in a table. You can view the results in 2 different ways:
procedure: You can switch view modes by clicking the icons in the upper left corner of the screen.
